exact_cause: The report text summary table populated the source footprint major median column using the R3 reference central ROI Jacobian value (1.6388 at 12K, and 1.6388 * (12/16) = 1.2291 at 16K, as documented in P2R16_R4P83R3_FILTER_STUDY.json). In contrast, the R4 Python pipeline computed the footprint array directly via finite differences across the full 360-degree cylindrical band (4096x623), where the full-band median evaluated to 1.5934 at 12K and 1.1951 at 16K. Both metrics agree that projection minification drops from ~1.51-1.64x to ~1.14-1.23x, and both confirm diminishing MTF detail returns (+1.06% at 16K, +0.61% at 18.432K).
